capabilities: Sync InfoFlow items into the vault manually or on a schedule
Convert saved HTML content to Markdown
Customize file name and note templates with variables and frontmatter
Import highlights and annotations into notes
Filter synced items by date range, tags, and folders
extras: The manifest description positions it as similar to ReadWise and Omnivore, though the README itself does not. Docs note a paid InfoFlow subscription will be required for the API token in the future, and that local InfoFlow versions using Google Drive or OneDrive are not supported.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to pull content and highlights saved in the InfoFlow read-it-later service into a vault.
summary: Sync service that imports saved articles, web pages, videos, notes, and highlights from InfoFlow.app into the vault as templated Markdown notes.
